summary: Sussex County, DE state tower erected 1931, turned over to State Police communications, and removed between 2002 and 2006; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 100-foot steel Aermotor LS-40 with a seven-foot square cabin, upper half enclosed in glass
facts.status_note: Removed sometime between 2002 and 2006 after being turned over to State Police for communications purposes

staffing.status: Staffed by towermen, per state forester reports of the 1930s and 1940s

facts.agency: Delaware state forestry department (annual reports of the State Forester)

events.note: Erection started July 29, 1931; towers opened for service October 15, 1931. FFLOS also gives 1931.
Towermen worked each tower; a small map was placed in each so towermen could check one another's locations of a smoke
Window sash and framing replaced with a new design
Insulated cabin ceiling installed; Ellendale was the last of three towers improved (year is the FY1946 report year)
Wired for electric power following a contract for radio installation
Turned over to State Police for communications purposes, then removed sometime between 2002 and 2006. The year is the earliest bound of that range, not a confirmed date.
Registered September 11, 2008 as FFLOS US 71, DE 2

corrections.why: Sources describe a 100-foot tower, 100 feet from the ground to the cabin floor and 110 feet overall. The 15.2 m value is about 50 feet.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 14 m matches the association's 46 ft (14 m). The 1931 state report describes the site on a 50-foot elevation. The record keeps the association figure; the two may measure different things.

notes_for_editor: Removal date rests on the association's pages ('between 2002-2006'); no state or agency record was found, and the State Police hand-over has no date. The association says the tower stood 'at DOT compound', while the 1931 report puts the site beside Ellendale-Milton State Highway; the sources do not say whether they are the same place. Sources 3 and 4 are a fan site transcribing state annual reports, not the originals; the Delaware Public Archives may hold them. No access, visit or current-condition data was found, so those keys are omitted. The record's height_m is corrected in corrections. Two web searches used.
